# GPU split: measurements

**Historical state (Ollama, 2026-11-13).** Generated by `scripts\Measure-GpuSetups.ps1`, which was removed with
the switch to llama.cpp on 2026-11-14 (git history before the first public version, up to `fbb8c80`). The values stay as evidence for [gpu-tuning.md](gpu-tuning.md).
As of 2026-11-13 20:52. Raw data: `logs\gpu-setups\results.jsonl`.
The setups were in `config\gpu-setups.json`. Assessment: [gpu-tuning.md](gpu-tuning.md).

Columns: **Weights** = model weights in GB per device according to llama.cpp (CPU = in main memory;
in the single-GPU tests the only visible card is always called 5070Ti, see the setup name).
With `tensor` llama.cpp does not report the weights per card (`Meta()`). **Speed empty** = generation speed without context (median),
**Speed 17k** = generation speed after a prompt of about 17,000 tokens, **Prompt** = processing
of that prompt. **MTP** = speculative decoding active. **Layers** = layers on the GPU according to
llama.cpp (Ollama's GPU figure shows 100 % even when layers are in main memory).
All values come from the last load in the run (a reload with other options is detected).
